title: OpenQC Algorithm Entry (four-axis model)
description: Schema for algorithm.json files at the root of every openqc-io/algo-* repo. Models an algorithm using four orthogonal axes (owner, scope, access, implementation_mode) plus classification fields. See PRPs/community-algorithms/taxonomy.md for the canonical model.

slug.description: URL-safe unique identifier. Must match the repo name suffix (algo-{slug}).

version.description: Semver version string for the algorithm package.

author.description: GitHub username or organization that maintains this algorithm.

description.description: Brief description of the algorithm (1-2 sentences).

owner.description: Primary axis. Who owns the algorithm. `user` (workspace-local) is NOT a valid owner in catalog-published algorithm.json — those rows are platform-internal.

scope.description: Primary axis. Every catalog-published algorithm.json has scope=catalog. `workspace` rows never publish to the index repo; they live workspace-local in MongoDB only.

access.description: Overlay axis. Distribution policy for the executable artifact. open: code visible in repo; gated: free, request access; paid: pricing applies; private: invite-only.

implementation_mode.description: Overlay axis. How the executable artifact is delivered. catalog_synced: template.py shipped in repo at pinned commit_sha; hosted_api: executable lives behind a provider URL (`provider_url` required).

provider_url.description: Required when implementation_mode=hosted_api. HTTPS endpoint that accepts a run request and returns a job result. Code never reaches the platform.

industries.description: Application-domain tags. Must validate against TAXONOMY.json#/industries. Note: `optimization` and `education` are NOT industries — use technique facets (qaoa/annealing) and the `foundational` industry instead.

techniques.description: Quantum technique tags. Must validate against TAXONOMY.json#/techniques. Note: `vqa` is not a tag — use the specific family (`vqe` or `qaoa`).

computation_model.description: Hardware/runtime model. gate|annealing|analog|mbqc map to quantum backends; classical is for classical-baseline algorithms (exact-diag, tensor networks) that ship as comparators.

algorithm_type.description: Execution type — determines job routing and result format.

qubit_count.description: Number of qubits (or problem variables for annealing/classical).

min_qubits.description: Minimum useful qubit count for scalable algorithms.

tags.description: Free-form searchable tags. Not validated against TAXONOMY.

access_reason.description: Why this algorithm is gated/paid/private. Shown to users requesting access.

pricing.description: Required when access=paid; forbidden otherwise. Validated by allOf at the bottom of this schema.

trial_runs.description: Number of free trial runs before payment required (per_run only).

circuit_qasm_path.description: Relative path to the OpenQASM 2.0 circuit file in this repo (typically circuit.qasm). Omitted when implementation_mode=hosted_api.

template_path.description: Relative path to the executor module (typically template.py). Omitted when implementation_mode=hosted_api.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema for algorithm input parameters.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the algorithm package.

blockers.description: Dependencies preventing materialization. Used with status: coming-soon.

metadata.description: Optional free-form metadata (complexity, year, references, etc.).

allOf.description: If access=paid then pricing is required.
If access != paid then pricing must be absent.
If implementation_mode=hosted_api then provider_url is required.
